column1: For example, suppose that the typical consumer buys five apples and two oranges every month. Then the basket of goods consists of five apples and two oranges, and the CPI is CPI.  (5  Current Price of Apples)  (2  Current Price of Oranges) (5  2014 Price of Apples)  (2  2014 Price of Oranges) . In this CPI, 2014 is the base year. The index tells us how much it costs now to buy five apples and two oranges relative to how much it cost to buy the same basket of fruit in 2014.
